newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends at lows on funds, barley sets lows.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends at lows on funds, barley sets lows.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended at its lows on fund selling and barley set new lows in the three nearby contracts for the second day in a row, traders said.

"Funds sold 2,000 January and some March, longs are liquidating November positions, Cargill was the featured buyer, UGG and LFG bought Nov-Jan," a trader said. Nov-Jan spread at $6.30, Nov-Mar $9, May-July $2. November futures crush margin rose to -31.37 from -32.98 Wednesday. Volume was very heavy at 13,555 lots, or 271,100 tonnes, with 750 hedges.
November canola fell $9.20 to $386, January lost $8.60 to $392.10. November flax fell $4.50 to $352 on liquidation.
UGG bought the Nov-Jan flax spread at $4.30, traders said.
UGG bought 60 December peas down US$2.50 at US$196, traders said. Oats did not trade.

November western barley lost $2 to $136.50 on long liquidation. Nov, Feb and March set new lows. Cargill sold February down $1.40 to $140.70. Nov-Feb spread at $3, Nov-Mar $4.50 and July-Oct $0.50. Volume was heavy at 3,000 lots.
"Feed grains are looking for consumptive demand but they're only meeting short covering," a trader said.
December feed wheat futures lost $2.40 to $165.60 on commission spreading, traders said. New lows across board.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
